description: This file defines the interface WeightedEvaluation for weighted statistical calculations, including method signatures for evaluating weighted statistics over arrays.

classes.name: WeightedEvaluation
classes.description: Interface for weighted evaluation of statistical measures, providing method signatures for evaluating statistics with associated weights.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates a weighted statistical measure over the entire input array using the provided weights.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates a weighted statistical measure over a subset of the input array, specified by start index and length, using the provided weights.
